def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [(Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0], Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][1] / w) for row in grid]
    line_color = max({c for c, _ in row_modes}, key=lambda c: max(ratio for mode, ratio in row_modes if mode == c))
    fill_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != line_color).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(line_color) >= 0.60*w]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == line_color for r in range(h)) >= 0.65*h]
    out=[]
    for r1,r2 in zip(row_lines,row_lines[1:]):
        line=[]
        for c1,c2 in zip(col_lines,col_lines[1:]):
            corners=[grid[r1][c1],grid[r1][c2],grid[r2][c1],grid[r2][c2]]
            line.append(corners[0] if len(set(corners))==1 and corners[0]!=line_color else fill_color)
        out.append(line)
    while out and all(v==fill_color for v in out[0]): out.pop(0)
    while out and all(v==fill_color for v in out[-1]): out.pop()
    while out and out[0] and all(row[0]==fill_color for row in out):
        for row in out: row.pop(0)
    while out and out[0] and all(row[-1]==fill_color for row in out):
        for row in out: row.pop()
    return out or [[fill_color]]
